outcome: Ductal Arteriosus closure (spontaneous, medical, or procedural)
cohort: Extremely low birth weight (ELBW) infants classified by the mode of closure of their ductus arteriosus (spontaneous, medical, or procedural).
finding: Differences in genotype distribution for the rs8752 genetic variant of the HPGD gene and in haplotype distributions were associated with the mode of treatment for patent ductus arteriosus closure in ELBW infants, suggesting a specific HPGD genetic foundation for DA closure.
